title: The Canteen at Noon
text:
At half past twelve, the canteen fills up in less than a minute. Chairs scrape. Trays clatter. Somewhere near the drinks stall, two boys argue cheerfully about a football match.
Behind the noodle stall, Auntie Rosnah works without ever seeming to hurry. She remembers that the tall boy takes no chilli, and that the small girl in spectacles always wants extra soup.
By one o'clock the tables are empty again. Auntie Rosnah wipes down her counter, stacks the bowls, and sits for a few minutes with her own lunch. Tomorrow, she will do all of it once more.
